post.text:
Why you let #Browns Andrew Berry keep his job:

Mason Graham: ✅
Carson Schwesinger: ✅
Quinshon Judkins: ✅
Harold Fannin Jr.: ✅
Dillon Gabriel: ❌
Dylan Sampson: ❓
Shedeur Sanders: ❓
post.author_description: Sports social media | LA | Raised on Cleveland sports | Formerly @espncleveland, @247sports | Member @PFWAwriters | Kent State alum ⚡️
